beforeRestartAttempt.interpretation: Before the cutover attempt, port 8086 was provided by Docker Desktop and WSL relay forwarding rather than a standalone host entitlement-service binary.

afterRestartAttempt.interpretation: After the Docker Desktop restart attempt, port 8086 no longer had a live provider.

interpretation: The 8086 provider was identified before cutover, but it disappeared after the failed Docker Desktop recovery attempt.
